title: Elements of Algebraic Geometry (EGA) — Complete Linked English Reader, Cumulative Source Recheck
description:
Read first: open EGA_English_Complete_Linked_Reader.pdf. This independent complete linked English release contains EGA 0/I, II, III-1, III-2, and IV-1 through IV-4.

Standalone readers for EGA III-2, IV-1, IV-3, and IV-4 provide direct access to the largest independently rebuilt fascicles. Editable TeX, exact source identities, decisions, corrections, inverses, build evidence, visual verification, and SHA-256 manifests are preserved in the language release.
